plan: Validate each action completely before mutating session state.
Use small helpers for initial state, current prompt, screen construction, and error screens.
Keep I/O replaceable through injected objects implementing read_action() and display(screen).
mechanisms: Atomic validation-before-mutation preserves accepted session data on errors.
A state-derived prompt helper produces deterministic screens and appointment choices.
Fresh session dictionaries and copied appointment records prevent unintended aliasing.
Dependency injection keeps action acquisition and screen display compatible with standard-library unittest fakes.
